The Menu Board

Four signatures. Zero shortcuts.

These are the items Mama Dot's HOTS is known for — the ones folks drive out to Elizabethtown events and Sonora stops to get. Every one is made fresh to order.

The Talk of the Truck

Cheeseburger Eggrolls

All the comfort of a cheeseburger, rolled up crispy and golden. The signature that puts Mama Dot's HOTS on the map — crunchy outside, melty inside, made fresh to order.

Mama Dot's Story

A truck with a mother's name on it.

Mama Dot's HOTS is named for owner Troy Albea's late mother, Dorothy “Mama Dot” Albea. Every plate that leaves the window carries her name — and the standard that comes with it: comfort food, made fresh to order, served like family.

From its home base in Sonora, Kentucky, the truck rolls out to events across the area — including Elizabethtown events in August 2026 — feeding crowds at gatherings, staff lunches, bars and breweries.

The Name

Troy Albea names the truck for his late mother, Dorothy “Mama Dot” Albea.
